english.title: Fail to keep personal flying log book as required
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[a member of a flight crew of an aircraft registered in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..),]_
(B)_[a person who engaged in flying for the purpose of qualifying for the grant of a flight crew licence under the Air Navigation Order 2016,]_
(C)_[a person who engaged in flying for the purpose of qualifying for the grant of a flight crew licence issued by the CAA under Part-FCL,]_
(D)_[a person who engaged in flying for the purpose of qualifying for the grant, renewal or revalidation of a rating or certificate under the Air Navigation Order 2016,]_
(E)_[a person who engaged in flying for the purpose of qualifying for the grant, renewal or revalidation of a certificate under Part-FCL,]_

failed to keep a personal flying log in accordance with article 228 of the Air Navigation Order 2016 in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 228 and 265(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
